description.zh-CN: 驾驶小飞机穿行于谱面的音符与激活噪域之间，收集星星。五颗心、受击无敌、离开暂停及惩罚、随机补给与结算。游戏仅使用预览，不修改谱面。
description.en-US: Fly a small plane through the chart’s notes and active noise areas to collect stars. Five hearts, invincibility after a hit, pause and penalty when leaving, random pickups and a results screen. The game only uses the preview and never edits the chart.

description.zh-CN: 打开谱面后按下此键。游戏中再次按下会结束并恢复编辑。
description.en-US: Press after opening a chart. Pressing it again during play ends the game and returns to editing.
